regra.estatistica: median across the 5 seeds of (MAE_sent_GNN − MAE_sent_MLP) per cell
regra.tolerancia: data-derived, per cell: SD across the 5 seeds of the MLP MAE_sent in the cell itself (the MLP is deterministic given the seed; the SD measures the recipe dispersion). If dp_MLP < 0.01 dB, use the GNN SD. The tolerance is recorded per cell BEFORE reading the contrast.
regra.aceite: approximate parity if |median| <= tolerance in >= 6 of the 8 cells; otherwise, 'systematic difference' with the sign and magnitude reported
regra.proibido: fix 0.05 dB or 0.25 dB a priori (v2); report 'consistent in direction' without counting the seeds

nota_inferencia: cell (8) × training seed (5); GNN−MLP contrast paired by seed within the cell; the city is the unit of inference across cells (EV-5); no sign test across cells
